prompt: Did the child sleep well last night?

title: Q3 Night activity
prompt: What did the child do all night?
hint: Begin with "The child" and end with "all night." Say: "The child watched TV all night."
sample: The child watched TV all night.

ja.prompt: 子どもは夜じゅう何をしていましたか？
ja.hint: 「The child」で始めて「all night」で終わる文にしてください。例：「The child watched TV all night.」
ja.sample: The child watched TV all night.
